_comment: Alien (1979) / Nostromo MU/TH/UR 6000 aesthetic. Reference: typesetinthefuture.com (Berthold City Light font, green phosphor confirmed), ha-weylandyutani GitHub theme (#0d0a08 panel, #33ff33 phosphor green), filmsite.org (green letters). Motion tracker: blue, per Raspberry Pi Magazine M314 build. Ron Cobb Semiotic Standard: red=alive, yellow=hazard, blue=cold/cryo. NOT amber — that is Alien:Isolation's secondary terminal design choice, not the 1979 film.
